thought.text: Let me check how the metrics page handles a missing MongoDB connection to decide the right .env.local state.

reasoning_content:
The /metrics route returns 500 because the placeholder `<CLUSTER>` MONGODB_URI is in .env.local (copied from .env.example). The guide states that the MongoDB connection is only required when using the metrics feature. According to the .env.example comments: "Wenn nicht gesetzt, funktioniert die Anwendung ohne Datenbank." (If not set, the application works without a database.)

Let me check how the metrics page handles the absence of a DB. I'll look at the mongodb.ts and metrics code to see whether the app gracefully degrades when MONGODB_URI is unset.

Options:
1. Remove/comment out MONGODB_URI in .env.local (the app works without a DB according to the docs).
2. Keep the placeholder — in this case /metrics will 500, but this is an option documented as requiring MongoDB.

According to the docs, MongoDB is optional, and the application works without it. The 500 on /metrics with a placeholder URI is an expected consequence of the template's placeholder values. The guide says: "Die MongoDB-Verbindung ist nur erforderlich, wenn die Metriken-Funktionalität genutzt werden soll."

Let me test what happens if I comment out MONGODB_URI in .env.local — the metrics page might show a fallback state. Let me check the metrics route's code.

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "head -40 /workspace/src/lib/mongodb.ts; echo \"===METRICS===\"; find /workspace/src/app/metrics -name \"*.tsx\" | head -3; grep -n \"client\\|db\\.\\|getDb\\|isMetricsEnabled\\|MONGODB\" /workspace/src/app/metrics/page.tsx 2>/dev/null | head -10", "description": "Inspect mongodb lib and metrics page"}
